baseline_reproduction.result: Existing CLI sends the input path as fs-hwriteback payload; valid NUL-containing append-only input is rejected with EPERM. The added CLI regression fails on that binary.

validation.execution: Release Apple Clang SDK27.2 WFS_FSKIT=ON; disposable archive source without Git metadata, deny-default sandbox excludes home/keychain/publishing paths, loopback-only test transports.
regression_scope: CLI binary file with embedded NUL reaches resident daemon and appends to unchanged prefix
Combined explicit World and session selectors, and session-only requests
Changed prefix remains rejected without publication
Missing and over-256-KiB input files fail locally before dispatch, preserving sequence/data
Existing raw RPC and both FSKit callback transports pass

native_note: Only CLI request file-to-payload conversion changes. Wire protocol and frontend callbacks are unchanged; no additional native syscall capability is claimed.
